description: Get the seller account profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the seller account object.

description: Get the seller account health metrics.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the account health object.

description: Get the FW26 buying notes reference document.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the buying notes.

description: Get performance notifications, optionally filtered by severity.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a count and results list.

description: Search catalog items by keywords or identifiers.

keywords.description: Optional keyword substring matched on title/description.

identifiers_type.description: Optional identifier type: ASIN or SKU.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains numberOfResults, pagination, and items.

description: Get a single catalog item by ASIN.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the catalog item; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a seller's listing by seller id and SKU.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the listing; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new listing item for a seller SKU.

data.description: The listing attributes (productType, title, price, quantity, etc.).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the accepted listing; on failure (already exists), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing listing item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the accepted listing; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a listing item by seller id and SKU.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List orders with optional date, status, and channel filters.

created_after.description: Optional lower bound on purchase date.

created_before.description: Optional upper bound on purchase date.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains count, total, and a payload with Orders.

description: Get a single order by its Amazon order id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the order payload; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the line items for an order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the order items payload; on failure (order not found), output contains an error message.

description: Confirm shipment for an unshipped order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the shipment; on failure (not found or wrong status), output contains an error message.

description: Get FBA inventory summaries, optionally for specific SKUs.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a payload with inventorySummaries.

description: Set the total and in-stock quantity for a seller SKU.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the update; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List reports, optionally filtered by type and processing status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a payload with reports.

description: Get a single report by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the report payload; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Request a new report for a type and date range.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the created report id.

description: Get competitive pricing for an ASIN or SKU.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains competitive pricing; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get item offers for an ASIN.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains item offers; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List returns, optionally filtered by status and order id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains count, total, and results.

description: Get a single return by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the return; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Authorize (complete with refund) a return in Authorized status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms authorization; on failure (not found or wrong status), output contains an error message.

description: Close a return.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms closure; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
